scope: Documentation and handover assembly; no new scientific search or dynamics changes.

checks.command: Builder integration smoke and generated standalone verifier
checks.scope: Exact source copies, embedded PDF/Markdown, member set, timestamps/modes, deterministic ZIP, altered/extra-file rejection and existing-output refusal

assembly: Every handover build runs the staged verifier and archive checks before publishing outputs. The outer MANIFEST.json describes that exact final payload; it cannot include its own final checksum.
